case_rule: PascalCase only. `.muse/hooks.json` / settings.hooks keys and plugin `event` values must be PascalCase; a snake_case key silently loads nothing in a hooks file and is `unsupported-hook-event` in a plugin manifest. The snake_case forms are used for hook_key, context-block ids (`hook:<snake_event>:<scope>:<index>`) and the enterprise policy map.
foreign_event_compat: Claude Code's `Setup` parses in a foreign manifest with a warning (`recognized but is not run by Muse`) and is rejected in a native manifest; `PreSubmit`/`Error`/unknown names → `unsupported-hook-event`.

decision_kinds.block: stdout JSON `{"decision":"block","reason":"…"}` (reason required) → status blocked, effects ['blocked']; on Stop/SubagentStop it requests a continuation.
decision_kinds.context: stdout JSON `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` → a developer-role context block in the runtime_hook lane (order 900000+n).
decision_kinds.feedback: effect 'feedback' — the block reason is also fed back to the model as feedback_message (PostToolUse) or as a plain feedback effect (PostToolUseFailure).
decision_kinds.rewrite: PreToolUse only: `hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision:"allow"` + `updatedInput` → decision updated_input, effect rewrite_selected (bare allow without updatedInput is rejected; later rewrites supersede earlier ones as rewrite_ignored).
decision_kinds.permission_verdict: PermissionRequest only: `hookSpecificOutput.decision` = `{"behavior":"allow"}` or `{"behavior":"deny","message":"…"}` (ask / updatedInput / extra keys rejected; deny without message uses default reason `PermissionRequest hook denied approval`).
decision_kinds.skills_v1: UserPromptSubmit / PostToolUse foreground command hooks declaring outputCapabilities ["skills.v1"] may return `hookSpecificOutput.selectedSkills:[{id,path,description}]` (gated by MUSE_EXPERIMENTAL_HOOK_SELECTED_SKILLS + _APPLY).
decision_kinds.bare_stdout_context: Non-JSON stdout is injected as context ONLY on SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit; elsewhere it is accepted with no effect.

protocol.exit_codes: Only exit 2 blocks (stderr = reason). 0 = completed; 1/3/127 = status failed, non-blocking (fail-open). `muse exec` exits 1 on a hook block; the reason lands in the run record as terminal cancelled.
protocol.timeout: No default timeout — an omitted `timeout` lets a hook block forever; `timeout: 0` is clamped to 1 s; a string timeout drops the handler. Every shipped hook must set timeout ≥ 1.
protocol.shell: Config-file hooks run `command` via `$SHELL -c` (fallback /bin/sh when SHELL unset) with a 16-key scrubbed env; native plugin hooks take a `command` ARRAY (no shell, no placeholder expansion). Windows dispatches into PowerShell (`commandWindows` / `command_windows`).
protocol.plugin_data_dir_note: MUSE_PLUGIN_DATA_DIR is advertised but NOT created — mkdir -p it.
tiers: project (<ws>/.muse/hooks.json, trust-gated; never loads untrusted, no error) order 2
plugin (capabilities.hooks[], requires plugins gate to install + approve; runs ungated once trusted_enabled) order 100000+
protocol.matcher_semantics: `|`-separated word-only tokens = exact case-sensitive alternation; any regex metacharacter → compiled, unanchored match; invalid regex → group unmatchable; bare `*`, absent or "" = wildcard.

plugin_hook_fields.notes: compatibilityName must not collide with a built-in tool name; outputCapabilities must be exactly ["skills.v1"] and only on foreground UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse; async:true is accepted (consumes a display_order slot, emits no records).

protocol.config_hook_fields_note: `env`, `shell` are NOT handler fields (drop the handler). Unknown event keys drop only that key.
protocol.offline_test: MUSE_EXPERIMENTAL_PLUGINS=1 muse plugins hook test <plugin>:<hook> --fixture f.json --json — fixture must be {"event":"<Event>","stdin":{…}} (optional matcher_input, cwd). Does not require approval.
protocol.session_log: hook_run_started / hook_run_terminal records; stdout is elided unless the run failed; SessionEnd emits no terminal row; display_order is a session-wide counter over admitted handlers.

notes: The 17×3 capability matrix (block / continue:false / additionalContext) was measured per event with `muse plugins hook test` and re-confirmed cell-by-cell in the verification pass.
Hooks are not on the MSP wire: `muse schema` exports zero hook types; MSP sessions run no hooks.
Bare-stdout context injection on SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit only (verification R6).
